caveats: No availability arrays were used to infer form-change game scope.
All games arrays use concrete base-game IDs. Legends: Z-A Mega Dimension mechanics use lza with DLC context in notes.
Pokémon GO form changes/fusions, their costs and unlocks are outside this core-series slice and remain to be audited.
Cosmetic born-in forms, evolution, captures, cloning, battle disguise and Transform are not transition routes here.
Methods describe known actions and conditions, not a complete legality simulator. They do not model every item unlock, fusion-device occupied state, or all move replacement side effects.
The generic species sources are cached snapshots. Narrow modern gaps were checked against live Serebii/Bulbapedia pages on the review date.
Storage service values pc, day_care, nursery and bank are semantic service keys; bank is not an existing data/games identifier.
The reviewed item/form sections establish separation but do not document party-space requirements for each game; no spare-party-slot constraint is asserted by this manifest.
